name: Oil Rig Rotary Table
description: Torque provided by an external motor rotates the table, which can rotate a drill rod placed through the center of the table.
shortDescription: A rotary table for drilling in an oil rig.

logicNodes.label: Clamp
logicNodes.description: Attach a drill rod to the table. This will transfer any rotation of the table to the attached drill rod.

logicNodes.label: RPS
logicNodes.description: The rotations per second of the table.

logicNodes.label: Torque
logicNodes.description: Torque connection to power the rotation of the table.
